The following is a technical analysis of CC.D.C.USS.IP stock using five methods. Moving Averages: This method measures the trend and direction of the stock by taking the average of closing prices over a defined period of time. A score of 10 indicates a strong upward trend, while 0 indicates a strong downward trend. The moving averages for CC.D.C.USS.IP are neutral. MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence): This method measures the relationship between two moving averages to identify potential buy and sell signals. A score of 10 indicates a strong buy signal, while 0 indicates a strong sell signal. The MACD for CC.D.C.USS.IP is bearish. Fibonacci Retracement: This method identifies potential areas of support and resistance by dividing the distance between a high and a low price into Fibonacci ratios. A score of 10 indicates a strong support level, while 0 indicates a strong resistance level. The Fibonacci Retracement for CC.D.C.USS.IP shows support around the $392.50 level and resistance around the $394.50 level. Bollinger Bands: This method measures the volatility of a stock by placing two Bollinger Bands above and below a moving average. A score of 10 indicates high volatility, while 0 indicates low volatility. The Bollinger Bands for CC.D.C.USS.IP are neutral. Relative Strength Index (RSI): This method measures the momentum of a stock by comparing the magnitude of recent gains and losses. A score of 10 indicates overbought conditions, while 0 indicates oversold conditions. The RSI for CC.D.C.USS.IP is neutral.
